description: Ledger of `<file>.md §N` citations inside canonical artifacts whose target section does not exist in the spec prose. Every entry is a normative obligation asserted only by artifact prose, whose stated source has no home: that is a protocol gap, not a numbering slip, so it MUST NOT be repaired by editing the number. check_artifact_prose_section_refs consults this ledger.
ratchet: This list may only shrink. A new entry is admissible only together with the spec report that owns the gap it records; landing that report MUST remove the entry rather than renumber the citation.

exemptions.reason: operations-sync.md never carried a §4.4 in any commit, and no page defines the reversible soft-failed reducer state, its upgrade-to-accepted path, or the 'accepted MUST NOT degrade to rejected without a new governance event' rule. The only occurrence of the token in the prose tree is one bullet in zh/security/server-threat-model.md §2.3, which ranks failure-convergence strategies and does not define the state machine. Renumbering to that bullet would assert an obligation the bullet does not carry.
